resources.string: Shows a completely black, silent, touch-blocking screen above other apps and the lock screen. To leave it, tap 3 times, then press Volume Down 3 times within 10 seconds.
Pixel and Android reserve the real power button. Accessibility key filtering does not receive it, so this app cannot disable that safety control.
Do Not Disturb access: not allowed (optional)
Open display settings for Always-on display
Double-press Power control: available (will be disabled while off)
Double-press Power control: unavailable; set it to None manually, or grant secure-settings access with adb
The power button cannot be blocked

On Pixel phones, Android handles Power before app and accessibility-service key callbacks. Accessibility cannot intercept Power. If secure-settings access was granted with adb, Turn Off will temporarily set the double-press Power gesture to None and restore it on exit. Otherwise, set that gesture to None manually. Always-on display is system-owned; disable it manually in Pixel display settings.
